records.title: Memristors
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the wide range of applications for memristors, from non-volatile memory to advanced computing

records.title: Memristors
records.description: Memristors are electronic devices whose resistance changes in response to the history of electrical current flowing through them, enabling a memory of past electrical activity. In this Primer, Xu et al. outline the study of memristors as dynamic devices.

records.title: Sonochemistry
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the ultrasound transducer used to generate acoustic cavitation in the sonochemistry experiment.

records.title: Sonochemistry
records.description: This Primer explores the dynamics of acoustic cavitation bubbles, focusing on how the energy released during their collapse can be harnessed to drive chemical reactions. Applications, reactor design and practical recommendations for accurately assessing cavitation in chemistry are provided, offering a comprehensive guide for researchers in sonochemistry.

records.title: Nonresonant second-harmonic generation
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the different surfaces that can be studied with second harmonic generation, including planar, curved, and electrode interfaces.

records.title: Nonresonant second-harmonic generation
records.description: Second-harmonic generation (SHG) is a second-order nonlinear optical technique for probing molecular organization and electrostatics at interfaces. This Primer introduces intensity-based nonresonant and phase-resolved SHG and discusses how these approaches are implemented in practice, from experimental design and data collection to analysis, applications, reproducibility and future developments.

records.title: Agentic AI systems for scientific discovery
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the challenges and opportunities that come with implementing agentic AI systems in the laboratory.

records.title: Agentic AI systems for scientific discovery
records.description: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems enhance scientific workflows by structuring knowledge coordination through natural language interfaces. In this Primer, Feng et al. examine the challenges and opportunities involved in integrating AI agents in the laboratory.

records.title: Nanopore sequencing of cell-free DNA
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the various applications for nanopore sequencing of cell-free DNA from human blood samples.

records.title: Nanopore sequencing of cell-free DNA
records.description: Cell-free DNA is generally fragmented and present in low abundance, making its detection and characterization challenging. In this Primer, Korabečná et al. discuss the use of nanopore sequencing for cell-free analysis from blood samples, as well as associated technical challenges.

records.title: Engineering synthetic thermogels
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the formation of thermogels in poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG)–polyester-, polyurethane- and polypeptide-based systems.

records.title: Engineering synthetic thermogels
records.description: Thermogels are polymeric materials that transition between sol and gel states in response to temperature changes. In this Primer, Wang et al. outline the design, synthesis and characterization of synthetic thermogels.

records.title: Selective gas adsorption in microporous materials
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the different type of data collected from microporous adsorbents throughout the process from laboratory development to industrial application.

records.title: Selective gas adsorption in microporous materials
records.description: This Primer highlights micropore design principles governed by distinct separation mechanisms to resolve key performance trade-offs in industrial gas separations. It outlines the experimental workflow, discusses current material limitations and industrial challenges, and offers a perspective on emerging opportunities.

records.title: Polyoxometalates for redox chemistry
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the key features of the most prominent species of polyoxometalates.

records.title: Polyoxometalates for redox chemistry
records.description: Polyoxometalates (POMs) are anionic molecular metal oxide clusters composed of high-valent early transition metals. In this Primer, Anjass et al. describe how redox-active POMs are selected, synthesized, characterized and integrated into functional systems.

records.title: Optical photothermal infrared spectroscopy
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the experimental set-up for optical photothermal infrared spectroscopy, which can be used in transmission or reflection configuration and probe both IR- and Raman-active modes.

records.title: Optical photothermal infrared spectroscopy
records.description: Optical photothermal infrared spectroscopy is capable of submicrometre infrared analysis with minimal water interference and scattering artefacts. This indirect, non-contact pump–probe method circumvents the issues associated with direct infrared techniques and has been used to analyse a variety of systems, from hydrated tissue samples to microplastics and individual aerosol particles.

records.title: Bioinformatics for human long-read whole genome sequencing
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the use of long-read sequencing for examining previously overlooked sources of genetic and regulatory variation.

records.title: Constructing ultrafast labs in the modern era
records.description: As ultrafast laser laboratories modernize, researchers have the opportunity to leverage recent advances in equipment and artificial intelligence to develop the next generation of ultrafast systems.

records.title: Keeping pace with ultrafast methods
records.description: Ultrafast laser-based methods have better temporal and spatial resolution than continuous-wave approaches but often require complex and delicate instrumentation. Our newest Collection on ultrafast methods aims to facilitate knowledge transfer, share best practices and promote greater standardization across the ultrafast research community.

records.title: Taking the pulse of ultrafast spectroscopy
records.description: Advances in ultrafast laser technology have revolutionized the study of time-resolved phenomena across physics, chemistry, biology and materials science. Here, Giulio Cerullo, a pioneer in the development of optical parametric amplifiers and their application to ultrafast spectroscopy, shares his perspective on the current state of ultrafast methods.

records.title: Starting an ultrafast spectroscopy lab
records.description: Ultrafast spectroscopy uses ultrashort pulses of light to study structural dynamics on the fast timescales of chemical bond making and breaking, electron or spin transport, and nuclear motion in molecules. This Comment provides practical guidance on establishing an ultrafast spectroscopy lab to probe the relationship between structure and function.

records.title: Ultrafast laser pulses enable the next generation of nanoscale 3D additive manufacturing
records.description: Numerous emerging applications require nanoscale additive manufacturing, in particular, 3D printing, to make increasing strides in manufacturing throughput and resolution. Ultrafast lasers are a uniquely suited tool for spatially and temporally sculpting light fields to enable future advanced 3D nanoprinting methods.

records.title: Bioinformatics for human long-read whole-genome sequencing
records.description: Long-read sequencing facilitates observation of contiguous DNA molecules, providing access to variants previously ignored. In this Primer, Zheng et al. discuss the computational foundations of long-read genome analysis in human genomics.

records.title: Imaging mass cytometry
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the workflow for generating highly multiplexed tissue images using imaging mass cytometry.

records.title: Imaging mass cytometry
records.description: Imaging mass cytometry is a highly multiplexed tissue-imaging technique that allows the simultaneous in situ detection of up to 45 markers with subcellular-level resolution. In this Primer, Meyer et al. provide a comprehensive guide to the experimental imaging mass cytometry workflow.

records.title: In situ/operando X-ray methods for investigating high-temperature electrocatalysis
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the ways in which high-temperature electrochemical cells can be interrogated using X-ray techniques.

records.title: In situ/operando X-ray methods for investigating high-temperature electrocatalysis
records.description: High-temperature electrochemical devices operate at gas–solid interfaces in highly redox-active environments. In situ and operando characterization techniques are crucial for monitoring the structural, electronic and chemical changes that determine device performance and durability. In this Primer, Peng et al. review key X-ray-based in situ/operando methods used to study high-temperature electrocatalysis.

records.title: Positron annihilation spectroscopy
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the use of positrons, typically generated from radioisotopes, to detect crystalline imperfections, such as vacancies or void spaces, in positron annihilation spectroscopy.

records.title: Positron annihilation spectroscopy
records.description: This Primer provides an introduction to positron annihilation spectroscopy and its uses in studying atomic-scale structures in solids.

records.title: Noise-equivalent pressures of ultrasound detectors used in photoacoustic tomography
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the landscape of noise equivalent pressures (NEPs) for different detectors used in photoacoustic tomography.

records.title: Noise-equivalent pressures of ultrasound detectors used in photoacoustic tomography
records.description: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) is a biomedical imaging technique based on the use of optically excited ultrasound waves. In this Primer, Guggenheim et al. describe the noise-equivalent pressures reported in the literature for detectors applicable to PAT.

records.title: Neutron spin echo spectroscopy
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the instrumentation for neutron spin echo spectroscopy, which measures neutron velocity changes in a magnetic field using spin precession angle measurements.

records.title: Neutron spin echo spectroscopy
records.description: Neutron spin echo spectroscopy investigates internal dynamics and diffusion in materials, using advanced instruments and data collection techniques. In this Primer, Faraone et al. discuss how neutron spin echo spectroscopy can be used in both soft-matter and hard-matter sciences.

records.title: Peptide ligand discovery of G protein-coupled receptors
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the workflow for GPCR peptide discovery from biodiversity-derived sequences, structural data and peptide libraries.

records.title: Peptide ligand discovery of G protein-coupled receptors
records.description: Peptides have become an increasingly important and versatile ligand type for G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs). In this Primer, Hermes et al. discuss the experimental and computational workflows for assessing peptide–GPCR interactions.

records.title: Distributional regression using generalized additive models for location, scale and shape
records.description: This PrimeView discusses the range of data to which distributional regression can be applied to understand deviations from the response norm and their real-world impact.

records.title: Distributional regression using generalized additive models for location, scale and shape
records.description: Distributional regression models entire conditional response distributions. In this Primer, Merder et al. discuss how distributional regression is used to predict uncertainty and extreme conditions in ways often missed by classical regression and machine learning approaches.

records.title: Synthesis and applications of conductive polymers
records.description: This PrimeView highlights common conductive polymers, their electronic properties, and applications in flexible electronics and biocompatible devices.

records.title: Synthesis and applications of conductive polymers
records.description: Conductive polymers (CPs) are π-conjugated organic semiconductors that exhibit electrical conductivities similar to insulators and metals while maintaining the flexibility of plastics. This Primer provides an overview of the synthesis, conduction and doping mechanisms of CPs while emphasizing their functionality in flexible electronic circuits, biosensors and tissue engineering.

records.title: Solid-state laser cooling
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the standardized reporting procedures required when publishing results of laser cooling experiments.

records.title: Solid-state laser cooling
records.description: Solid-state laser cooling is a technique used to lower the temperature of a condensed-phase system through its interaction with light. In this Primer, Ding et al. discuss the fundamental principles of photoluminescence-based laser cooling, including material and experimental design.

records.title: Matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization imaging mass spectrometry
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the use of MALDI IMS in the untargeted mapping of various biomolecules to link their distribution to various cellular contexts.

records.title: Matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization imaging mass spectrometry
records.description: Matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization imaging mass spectrometry (MALDI IMS) is a label-free molecular imaging approach mapping diverse biomolecules at cellular resolution. In this Primer, Spraggins et al. outline MALDI IMS concepts, instrumentation, data processing and integration with spatial omics and medicine.

records.title: Cucurbit[n]uril-type molecular containers
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the different applications afforded to cucurbituril macrocycles due to their molecular-scale recognition and binding selectivity.

records.title: Cucurbit[ n ]uril-type molecular containers
records.description: Cucurbit[ n ]urils are macrocyclic host molecules that form strong complexes with hydrophobic and cationic guests in water, where n is the number of glycoluril units. Cucurbit[ n ]urils complexed with guest molecules are stimuli-responsive, making them useful in applications such as functional materials, chemical sensing and separations, drug delivery systems and bioimaging.

records.title: Enzyme tethering for in situ epigenomics
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the importance of correct data analysis for data generated using enzyme-tethering approaches for in situ epigenomics

records.title: Enzyme tethering for in situ epigenomics
records.description: Enzyme-tethering epigenomic methods modify DNA while cells and nuclei remain intact, making them particularly suitable for single-cell and spatial applications. In this Primer, Kami Ahmad et al. discuss the various approaches for enzyme-tethering analysis and major applications in biological research.

records.title: Magnetic tunnel junctions
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the fabrication of magnetic tunnel junctions to ensure correct function of the devices.

records.title: Magnetic tunnel junctions
records.description: Atomic-scale engineering of MgO-based magnetic tunnel junctions enables coherent spin-dependent tunnelling and large tunnelling magnetoresistance for advanced spintronic functionality. This Primer outlines materials, fabrication and characterization approaches, linking interfacial structure to magnetic behaviour while highlighting emerging tunnelling magnetoresistance technologies.

records.title: Dual-comb spectroscopy
records.description: This PrimeView features a typical experimental set-up for dual-comb spectroscopy on a laser table.

records.title: Dual-comb spectroscopy
records.description: Dual-comb spectroscopy utilizes two optical frequency combs for precise, rapid measurements, enhancing performance through time-domain interferometry. This Primer discusses the experimental set-up and fundamental theory for dual-comb spectroscopy, in addition to addressing limitations and exploring future applications across the electromagnetic spectrum.

records.title: Transient absorption spectroscopy
records.description: This PrimeView shows a typical transient absorption spectroscopy setup, including pump and probe laser sources, a controllable pump-probe delay, precise beam alignment and a detection system.

records.title: Transient absorption spectroscopy
records.description: Transient absorption spectroscopy is a pump–probe method used to investigate light-induced dynamics. In this Primer, He et al. describe various transient absorption set-ups and outline a workflow for data analysis, addressing limitations while highlighting applications in chemistry, physics and materials science, alongside emerging multimodal approaches.

records.title: Flow NMR for chemical synthesis
records.description: This PrimeView highlights a flow-NMR spectroscopy setup, including the specialized flow equipment required.

records.title: Flow NMR for chemical synthesis
records.description: Flow NMR spectroscopy offers real-time monitoring of chemical reactions, enabling quantitative analysis and mechanistic insights. This Primer describes the specialized equipment and tailored methods that can be applied to enhance its application across various fields, and addresses key challenges and limitations.

records.title: Laser Doppler vibrometry
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the various applications for laser doppler vibrometry, using sensors in the field to measure vibrations in infrastructure, the environment, and more.

records.title: Laser Doppler vibrometry
records.description: This Primer provides a comprehensive overview of laser Doppler vibrometry, covering fundamental principles, advanced measurement methods and diverse applications. It highlights performance limits, measurement ranges, future opportunities and practical considerations, including laser safety and calibration, and is supported by extensive supplementary information.

records.title: Expansion microscopy
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the expansion microscopy workflow, including how to expand biological samples and analysis of the expanded samples.

records.title: Expansion microscopy
records.description: Expansion microscopy enhances conventional imaging by physically enlarging samples within a hydrogel matrix, surpassing diffraction limits. In this Primer, Vo et al. detail typical expansion microscopy protocols, optimization strategies and applications across various biological disciplines, while addressing limitations and future innovations in imaging techniques and data analysis.

records.title: Precision genome editing with DNA base editors
records.description: This PrimeView highlights how the efficacy of base editing depends on the choice of base editor, deaminase, Cas and guide RNA.

records.title: When the plant becomes the material: rethinking nanoherbicide design through plant-informed nanodesign
records.description: Current nanoherbicide development is largely guided by a material-first design logic that overlooks the biological complexity determining nanoparticle transport, transformation and target-site access in plants. We propose plant-informed nanodesign; a biology-driven framework that integrates plant physiology into rational nanocarrier engineering, advancing the field from empirical screening towards predictive science.

records.title: Precision genome editing with DNA base editors
records.description: Base editing enables precise, programmable single-base changes using cytosine or adenine editors. This Primer outlines their use in mammalian cells for screening, disease modelling and therapy, covering experimental design, analysis, limitations and best-practice guidance to support effective implementation.

records.title: Magnetoresistance phenomena and measurement methodologies
records.description: This PrimeView features the different types of magnetoresistance phenomena and how data from each type might appear.

records.title: Magnetoresistance phenomena and measurement methodologies
records.description: Magnetoresistance is a fundamental transport phenomenon that provides deep insight into electronic structure, magnetic order and emergent quantum effects in solids. This Primer reviews major magnetoresistance phenomena and presents practical measurement methodologies, emphasizing experimental configurations, instrumental limitations, common artefacts and best practices for reliable data interpretation.

records.title: Ultrafast nano-imaging and nano-spectroscopy
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the bright advancements in ultrafast pump-probe nano-imaging, including developments with different pump and probe frequencies or in operando sample conditions.

records.title: Ultrafast nano-imaging and nano-spectroscopy
records.description: Ultrafast near-field microscopy unites femtosecond optical spectroscopy with nanometre spatial resolution to image non-equilibrium material dynamics beyond the diffraction limit. This Primer outlines theory, instrumentation, signal interpretation and representative applications, providing a practical foundation for generating and analysing ultrafast nano-movies of quantum materials.

records.title: Hyperspectral imaging
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the different features that can be identified from hyperspectral imaging, using an Earth observation image as an example.

records.title: Hyperspectral imaging
records.description: This Primer introduces hyperspectral imaging (HSI) through a concise, imaging-centric perspective, linking sensor platforms, data types and representative datasets across application domains. It highlights how platform characteristics shape data properties and downstream analysis, providing a unified reference for understanding and comparing HSI systems and data.

records.title: Quantum imaging with correlated photon pairs
records.description: This PrimeView features the four different experimental setups for quantum imaging with correlated photon pairs, including biphoton imaging, quantum ghost imaging, heralded imaging, and undetected photon imaging.

records.title: Quantum imaging with correlated photon pairs
records.description: This Primer provides an introduction to quantum imaging with correlated photon pairs, from core concepts to experimental realizations. It discusses potential advantages over classical imaging, practical design issues, and the emerging applications and challenges that will shape future progress of the field.

records.title: Fluidic force microscopy
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the breadth of applications for FluidFM in biological and materials research.

records.title: Fluidic force microscopy
records.description: Fluidic force microscopy combines atomic force microscopy with microfluidic probes to enable measurement and manipulation of materials at sub-micrometre resolution. In this Primer, Zambelli et al. discuss the principles of fluidic force microscopy and applications in biological research and nanotechnology.

records.title: Electrophoretic deposition
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the future integration of artificial intelligence in electrophoretic deposition.

records.title: Electrophoretic deposition
records.description: Electrophoretic deposition is a micropatterning method that utilizes suspension properties and kinetic parameters for film control. This Primer discusses innovative electrode design to enhance resolution and multimaterial integration, addresses limitations and suggests future optimization strategies across diverse applications.

records.title: Publisher Correction: Operando ultraviolet–visible optical spectroelectrochemistry of surfaces
Using Raman spectrometers developed for space exploration in other extreme environments
records.description: Optimizing Raman spectrometer designs for use in extreme environments can enable acquisition of critical information that may not be accessible in situ by humans. Technology advancements currently being made for space exploration can be exploited in order for such spectrometers to be used in dangerous terrestrial environments.

records.title: Design for end of life: how circularity can offer a different path for solar energy
records.description: With the rising success of solar photovoltaics, long-term sustainability needs to be addressed. We provide practical steps that researchers, journals and the wider community can take to embed circularity into emerging photovoltaics, from the conception of a new idea, to lab scale demonstrations, to scale-up.

records.title: The future of reflexivity in practice: building a collective methodological agenda
records.description: Reflexivity is increasingly recognized as a cornerstone of high-quality research, yet methodological guidance on how to do reflexivity in practice remains limited. Drawing on emerging initiatives to operationalize reflexivity, three priorities for advancing a collective agenda are identified — turning reflexivity into a teachable, actionable set of methods.

records.title: Towards credible digital twins for basic and preclinical research
records.description: Digital twins are well established in industrial settings, but there has not been wide adoption in biomedical settings. Digital twins for biomedical applications are now possible with the inclusion of artificial intelligence and the potential to combine mechanistic and clinical models that learn and adjust for human variability.

records.title: Promoting open and transparent research in an AI-driven world
records.description: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used for data analysis, literature synthesis and experimental design, posing a challenge to open research. Here, David Moher of the Ottawa Hospital Research Institute discusses how researchers, institutes, funders and publishers all have a role in keeping research transparent.

records.title: Keeping the light on: understanding methods as AI redraws the map
records.description: Methods shape the questions we ask and the discoveries we make. To adopt a method is to expand the boundaries of scientific imagination. As we celebrate our fifth anniversary, we look to how new methodological frontiers redefine what is possible.

records.title: Setting the standard on chemistry terms and symbols
records.description: Clear, consistent communication is essential in science and a goal Nature Reviews Methods Primers addresses with the ‘Reproducibility and data deposition’ section in Primers. Here, Brynn Hibbert of the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry shares insights on new projects and evolving symbols that help to standardize chemistry.

records.title: Defending the credibility of science in the age of AI
records.description: Artificial intelligence is increasingly changing the landscape of how people interact with and communicate research findings. Here, Rainer Bromme discusses challenges to maintaining credibility in scientific research in the age of artificial intelligence and the responsibility of researchers, institutions, funders and publishers in improving trust in science.

records.title: The growing role of reproducibility networks
records.description: The UK Reproducibility Network (UKRN) was established to promote robust and transparent research and drive research quality. Here, Marcus Munafò, a founding member of the UKRN, outlines the role of Reproducibility Networks as methods and technology evolves.

records.title: Materials design for the future with AI assistance
records.description: Advancements in artificial intelligence and machine learning are reshaping scientific research, with notable benefits for materials design and modelling. We spoke with Aron Walsh, Professor in Materials Design at Imperial College London, about emerging opportunities in computationally driven materials science and advice for researchers looking to integrate artificial intelligence into their work.

records.title: Student-focused strategies for designing successful undergraduate research projects
records.description: Designing research projects for undergraduates can be challenging due to their limited experience and time constraints. In this Comment, Joshua Patterson, a professor at a primarily undergraduate institution, shares strategies for creating meaningful research opportunities for undergraduate students.

records.title: Matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization imaging mass spectrometry
records.description: Matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization imaging mass spectrometry (MALDI IMS) is a label-free molecular imaging approach mapping diverse biomolecules at cellular resolution. In this Primer, Spraggins et al. outline MALDI IMS concepts, instrumentation, data processing and integration with spatial omics and medicine.

records.title: Cucurbit[n]uril-type molecular containers
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the different applications afforded to cucurbituril macrocycles due to their molecular-scale recognition and binding selectivity.

records.title: Cucurbit[ n ]uril-type molecular containers
records.description: Cucurbit[ n ]urils are macrocyclic host molecules that form strong complexes with hydrophobic and cationic guests in water, where n is the number of glycoluril units. Cucurbit[ n ]urils complexed with guest molecules are stimuli-responsive, making them useful in applications such as functional materials, chemical sensing and separations, drug delivery systems and bioimaging.

records.title: Enzyme tethering for in situ epigenomics
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the importance of correct data analysis for data generated using enzyme-tethering approaches for in situ epigenomics

records.title: Enzyme tethering for in situ epigenomics
records.description: Enzyme-tethering epigenomic methods modify DNA while cells and nuclei remain intact, making them particularly suitable for single-cell and spatial applications. In this Primer, Kami Ahmad et al. discuss the various approaches for enzyme-tethering analysis and major applications in biological research.

records.title: Magnetic tunnel junctions
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the fabrication of magnetic tunnel junctions to ensure correct function of the devices.

records.title: Magnetic tunnel junctions
records.description: Atomic-scale engineering of MgO-based magnetic tunnel junctions enables coherent spin-dependent tunnelling and large tunnelling magnetoresistance for advanced spintronic functionality. This Primer outlines materials, fabrication and characterization approaches, linking interfacial structure to magnetic behaviour while highlighting emerging tunnelling magnetoresistance technologies.

records.title: Dual-comb spectroscopy
records.description: This PrimeView features a typical experimental set-up for dual-comb spectroscopy on a laser table.

records.title: Dual-comb spectroscopy
records.description: Dual-comb spectroscopy utilizes two optical frequency combs for precise, rapid measurements, enhancing performance through time-domain interferometry. This Primer discusses the experimental set-up and fundamental theory for dual-comb spectroscopy, in addition to addressing limitations and exploring future applications across the electromagnetic spectrum.

records.title: Transient absorption spectroscopy
records.description: This PrimeView shows a typical transient absorption spectroscopy setup, including pump and probe laser sources, a controllable pump-probe delay, precise beam alignment and a detection system.

records.title: Transient absorption spectroscopy
records.description: Transient absorption spectroscopy is a pump–probe method used to investigate light-induced dynamics. In this Primer, He et al. describe various transient absorption set-ups and outline a workflow for data analysis, addressing limitations while highlighting applications in chemistry, physics and materials science, alongside emerging multimodal approaches.

records.title: Flow NMR for chemical synthesis
records.description: This PrimeView highlights a flow-NMR spectroscopy setup, including the specialized flow equipment required.

records.title: Flow NMR for chemical synthesis
records.description: Flow NMR spectroscopy offers real-time monitoring of chemical reactions, enabling quantitative analysis and mechanistic insights. This Primer describes the specialized equipment and tailored methods that can be applied to enhance its application across various fields, and addresses key challenges and limitations.

records.title: Laser Doppler vibrometry
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the various applications for laser doppler vibrometry, using sensors in the field to measure vibrations in infrastructure, the environment, and more.

records.title: Laser Doppler vibrometry
records.description: This Primer provides a comprehensive overview of laser Doppler vibrometry, covering fundamental principles, advanced measurement methods and diverse applications. It highlights performance limits, measurement ranges, future opportunities and practical considerations, including laser safety and calibration, and is supported by extensive supplementary information.

records.title: Expansion microscopy
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the expansion microscopy workflow, including how to expand biological samples and analysis of the expanded samples.

records.title: Expansion microscopy
records.description: Expansion microscopy enhances conventional imaging by physically enlarging samples within a hydrogel matrix, surpassing diffraction limits. In this Primer, Vo et al. detail typical expansion microscopy protocols, optimization strategies and applications across various biological disciplines, while addressing limitations and future innovations in imaging techniques and data analysis.

records.title: Precision genome editing with DNA base editors
records.description: This PrimeView highlights how the efficacy of base editing depends on the choice of base editor, deaminase, Cas and guide RNA.

records.title: When the plant becomes the material: rethinking nanoherbicide design through plant-informed nanodesign
records.description: Current nanoherbicide development is largely guided by a material-first design logic that overlooks the biological complexity determining nanoparticle transport, transformation and target-site access in plants. We propose plant-informed nanodesign; a biology-driven framework that integrates plant physiology into rational nanocarrier engineering, advancing the field from empirical screening towards predictive science.

records.title: Precision genome editing with DNA base editors
records.description: Base editing enables precise, programmable single-base changes using cytosine or adenine editors. This Primer outlines their use in mammalian cells for screening, disease modelling and therapy, covering experimental design, analysis, limitations and best-practice guidance to support effective implementation.

records.title: Magnetoresistance phenomena and measurement methodologies
records.description: This PrimeView features the different types of magnetoresistance phenomena and how data from each type might appear.

records.title: Magnetoresistance phenomena and measurement methodologies
records.description: Magnetoresistance is a fundamental transport phenomenon that provides deep insight into electronic structure, magnetic order and emergent quantum effects in solids. This Primer reviews major magnetoresistance phenomena and presents practical measurement methodologies, emphasizing experimental configurations, instrumental limitations, common artefacts and best practices for reliable data interpretation.

records.title: Ultrafast nano-imaging and nano-spectroscopy
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the bright advancements in ultrafast pump-probe nano-imaging, including developments with different pump and probe frequencies or in operando sample conditions.

records.title: Ultrafast nano-imaging and nano-spectroscopy
records.description: Ultrafast near-field microscopy unites femtosecond optical spectroscopy with nanometre spatial resolution to image non-equilibrium material dynamics beyond the diffraction limit. This Primer outlines theory, instrumentation, signal interpretation and representative applications, providing a practical foundation for generating and analysing ultrafast nano-movies of quantum materials.

records.title: Hyperspectral imaging
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the different features that can be identified from hyperspectral imaging, using an Earth observation image as an example.

records.title: Hyperspectral imaging
records.description: This Primer introduces hyperspectral imaging (HSI) through a concise, imaging-centric perspective, linking sensor platforms, data types and representative datasets across application domains. It highlights how platform characteristics shape data properties and downstream analysis, providing a unified reference for understanding and comparing HSI systems and data.

records.title: Quantum imaging with correlated photon pairs
records.description: This PrimeView features the four different experimental setups for quantum imaging with correlated photon pairs, including biphoton imaging, quantum ghost imaging, heralded imaging, and undetected photon imaging.

records.title: Quantum imaging with correlated photon pairs
records.description: This Primer provides an introduction to quantum imaging with correlated photon pairs, from core concepts to experimental realizations. It discusses potential advantages over classical imaging, practical design issues, and the emerging applications and challenges that will shape future progress of the field.

records.title: Fluidic force microscopy
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the breadth of applications for FluidFM in biological and materials research.

records.title: Fluidic force microscopy
records.description: Fluidic force microscopy combines atomic force microscopy with microfluidic probes to enable measurement and manipulation of materials at sub-micrometre resolution. In this Primer, Zambelli et al. discuss the principles of fluidic force microscopy and applications in biological research and nanotechnology.

records.title: Electrophoretic deposition
records.description: This PrimeView highlights the future integration of artificial intelligence in electrophoretic deposition.

records.title: Electrophoretic deposition
records.description: Electrophoretic deposition is a micropatterning method that utilizes suspension properties and kinetic parameters for film control. This Primer discusses innovative electrode design to enhance resolution and multimaterial integration, addresses limitations and suggests future optimization strategies across diverse applications.

records.title: Publisher Correction: Operando ultraviolet–visible optical spectroelectrochemistry of surfaces
Using Raman spectrometers developed for space exploration in other extreme environments
records.description: Optimizing Raman spectrometer designs for use in extreme environments can enable acquisition of critical information that may not be accessible in situ by humans. Technology advancements currently being made for space exploration can be exploited in order for such spectrometers to be used in dangerous terrestrial environments.

records.title: Design for end of life: how circularity can offer a different path for solar energy
records.description: With the rising success of solar photovoltaics, long-term sustainability needs to be addressed. We provide practical steps that researchers, journals and the wider community can take to embed circularity into emerging photovoltaics, from the conception of a new idea, to lab scale demonstrations, to scale-up.

records.title: The future of reflexivity in practice: building a collective methodological agenda
records.description: Reflexivity is increasingly recognized as a cornerstone of high-quality research, yet methodological guidance on how to do reflexivity in practice remains limited. Drawing on emerging initiatives to operationalize reflexivity, three priorities for advancing a collective agenda are identified — turning reflexivity into a teachable, actionable set of methods.

records.title: Towards credible digital twins for basic and preclinical research
records.description: Digital twins are well established in industrial settings, but there has not been wide adoption in biomedical settings. Digital twins for biomedical applications are now possible with the inclusion of artificial intelligence and the potential to combine mechanistic and clinical models that learn and adjust for human variability.

records.title: Promoting open and transparent research in an AI-driven world
records.description: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used for data analysis, literature synthesis and experimental design, posing a challenge to open research. Here, David Moher of the Ottawa Hospital Research Institute discusses how researchers, institutes, funders and publishers all have a role in keeping research transparent.

records.title: Keeping the light on: understanding methods as AI redraws the map
records.description: Methods shape the questions we ask and the discoveries we make. To adopt a method is to expand the boundaries of scientific imagination. As we celebrate our fifth anniversary, we look to how new methodological frontiers redefine what is possible.

records.title: Setting the standard on chemistry terms and symbols
records.description: Clear, consistent communication is essential in science and a goal Nature Reviews Methods Primers addresses with the ‘Reproducibility and data deposition’ section in Primers. Here, Brynn Hibbert of the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry shares insights on new projects and evolving symbols that help to standardize chemistry.

records.title: Defending the credibility of science in the age of AI
records.description: Artificial intelligence is increasingly changing the landscape of how people interact with and communicate research findings. Here, Rainer Bromme discusses challenges to maintaining credibility in scientific research in the age of artificial intelligence and the responsibility of researchers, institutions, funders and publishers in improving trust in science.

records.title: The growing role of reproducibility networks
records.description: The UK Reproducibility Network (UKRN) was established to promote robust and transparent research and drive research quality. Here, Marcus Munafò, a founding member of the UKRN, outlines the role of Reproducibility Networks as methods and technology evolves.

records.title: Materials design for the future with AI assistance
records.description: Advancements in artificial intelligence and machine learning are reshaping scientific research, with notable benefits for materials design and modelling. We spoke with Aron Walsh, Professor in Materials Design at Imperial College London, about emerging opportunities in computationally driven materials science and advice for researchers looking to integrate artificial intelligence into their work.

records.title: Student-focused strategies for designing successful undergraduate research projects
records.description: Designing research projects for undergraduates can be challenging due to their limited experience and time constraints. In this Comment, Joshua Patterson, a professor at a primarily undergraduate institution, shares strategies for creating meaningful research opportunities for undergraduate students.
